chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'Is travel disliked on any of the disliked days, such as Wednesday and others?' So he (peace be upon him) said, 'Begin your travel with charity, and recite the Verse of the Throne when it becomes apparent to you.'

key_terms.آيَةَ الْكُرْسِيِّ: The Verse of the Throne (Ayat al-Kursi)

ai.seo_question: What are the recommended actions to perform when starting a journey according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that while certain days like Wednesday may be considered *makruh* for travel, the spiritual remedy lies in proactive piety rather than avoidance. By initiating the journey with charity (*sadaqah*) and reciting Ayat al-Kursi, the traveler invokes divine protection and blessings, transforming a potentially inauspicious time into an opportunity for spiritual merit.
